name: 小马智行登录助手
author: protocol-reverse
description: 小马智行（Pony Pilot）手机号验证码登录，产出 Flask session cookie 作为 token。用 set.js 逃生舱 + forge 库直接构造 protobuf bytes 并做 RSA 加密，绕过 fn.rsaPkcs1 的字符串编码问题。

js.code: function ev(v){var o=[];while(v>0x7F){o.push((v&0x7F)|0x80);v>>>=7;}o.push(v&0x7F);return o;}function tg(f,w){return ev((f<<3)|w);}function pb(f,d){return tg(f,2).concat(ev(d.length)).concat(d);}function ps(f,s){var b=[];for(var i=0;i<s.length;i++){var c=s.charCodeAt(i);if(c<0x80)b.push(c);else if(c<0x800){b.push(0xC0|(c>>6),0x80|(c&0x3F));}else{b.push(0xE0|(c>>12),0x80|((c>>6)&0x3F),0x80|(c&0x3F));}}return pb(f,b);}function pi(f,v){return tg(f,0).concat(ev(v));}function hx(b){var h='';for(var i=0;i<b.length;i++)h+=(b[i]<16?'0':'')+b[i].toString(16);return h;}var ua='version=1.5.0;build=215060022;platform=android;app=ai.pony.app.pilotcn;display_version=2.15.6.22';var hdr=pi(1,1).concat(pi(2,2)).concat(pi(3,2)).concat(ps(6,ua)).concat(pi(7,0));var pt=ps(1,phone);var pub=forge.pki.publicKeyFromPem(pem);var pts='';for(var i=0;i<pt.length;i++)pts+=String.fromCharCode(pt[i]);var enc=pub.encrypt(pts,'RSAES-PKCS1-V1_5');var eh=forge.util.bytesToHex(enc);var eb=[];for(var i=0;i<eh.length;i+=2)eb.push(parseInt(eh.substr(i,2),16));var body=pb(3,[]).concat(pb(10000,hdr)).concat(pb(10001,eb)).concat(ps(10002,fn.uuid())).concat(ps(10003,fn.uuid()));return hx(body);

onFail.message: 发送验证码失败，请检查手机号是否正确
